```{r setup, include=FALSE}

library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)

library(janitor)
library(here)
library(haven)

```

```{r Census Data Pull, include=TRUE}
years <- c(2007,2022)

get_pums_data <- function(year) {
  get_pums(
    variables = c(
      "HINCP",
      "GRNTP",
      "SMOCP",
      "TEN",
      "PWGTP"
    ),
    survey = "acs1",
    year = year,
    state = "all"
  ) %>%
    select(SERIALNO, HINCP, GRNTP, SMOCP, TEN, PWGTP) %>%
    rename(
      income = HINCP,
      rent = GRNTP,
      owner_cost = SMOCP,
      tenure = TEN,
      weight = PWGTP
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      across(c(income, rent, owner_cost, tenure, weight), as.numeric)
    ) %>%
    mutate(year = year)
}

pums <- bind_rows(lapply(years, get_pums_data))
```

```{r Income Distribution and Cost Burden, include=TRUE}
pums1 <- pums %>%
  group_by(year, SERIALNO) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup()


# Diagnostic Work on IPUMS Data
summary(pums$income)
table(is.na(pums$income)) 
nrow(pums)
summary(pums$income <= "-60000")

pums_clean <- pums %>%
  mutate(
    housing_cost = case_when(
      tenure == 3 ~ rent,
      tenure %in% c(1, 2) ~ owner_cost,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    
    cost_burdened = ifelse(
      !is.na(housing_cost) & income > 0,
      (housing_cost * 12) / income >= 0.30,
      NA
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(cost_burdened),
    income > 0   # 🔥 drop zero + negative income
  )

pums_clean <- pums_clean %>%
  mutate(
    income_bracket = cut(
      income,
      breaks = c(0, 25000, 50000, 75000, 100000, 150000, Inf),
      labels = c("<25k", "25–50k", "50–75k", "75–100k", "100–150k", "150k+")
    )
  )

summary_df <- pums_clean %>%
  group_by(year, income_bracket) %>%
  summarize(
    share_burdened = weighted.mean(cost_burdened, weight, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


burden_plot <- ggplot(summary_df, aes(x = income_bracket, y = share_burdened, fill = factor(year))) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  
  labs(
    title = "Share of Households Cost-Burdened by Income",
    subtitle = "2007 vs. Recent Year",
    x = "Income bracket",
    y = "Share cost-burdened (≥30% of income)",
    fill = "Year"
  ) +
  
  theme_minimal()

print(burden_plot)
```

```{r Cost Burden Plot - Faceted, include=TRUE}
pums_clean <- pums_clean %>%
  mutate(
    tenure_label = case_when(
      tenure %in% c(1, 2) ~ "Owner",
      tenure == 3 ~ "Renter",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

summary_df <- pums_clean %>%
  group_by(year, tenure_label, income_bracket) %>%
  summarize(
    share_burdened = weighted.mean(cost_burdened, weight, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

burden_plot_facet <- ggplot(summary_df, aes(x = income_bracket, y = share_burdened, fill = factor(year))) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  
  facet_wrap(~tenure_label) +
  
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  
  labs(
    title = "Housing Cost Burden by Income and Tenure",
    subtitle = "2007 vs. 2022",
    x = "Income bracket",
    y = "Share cost-burdened (≥30%)",
    fill = "Year"
  ) +
  
  theme_minimal()

print(burden_plot_facet)

ggsave(
  filename = "cost_burden.png",
  plot = burden_plot_facet
)

```


```{r More Comprehensive Time Series, include=TRUE}
years <- c(2007, 2010, 2013, 2016, 2019, 2022)

get_pums_data_more <- function(year, sample_size = 5000) {
  get_pums(
    variables = c(
      "HINCP",
      "GRNTP",
      "SMOCP",
      "TEN",
      "PWGTP",
      "PUMA",
      "ST"
    ),
    survey = "acs1",
    year = year,
    state = "all"
  ) %>%
    
    # keep only needed variables
    dplyr::select(SERIALNO, HINCP, GRNTP, SMOCP, TEN, PWGTP, PUMA, ST) %>%
    
    # rename
    dplyr::rename(
      income = HINCP,
      rent = GRNTP,
      owner_cost = SMOCP,
      tenure = TEN,
      weight = PWGTP,
      puma = PUMA,
      state = ST
    ) %>%
    
    # enforce types
    dplyr::mutate(
      dplyr::across(c(income, rent, owner_cost, tenure, weight),
                    ~ suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.))),
      year = year
    ) 
}

pums_more <- bind_rows(lapply(years, get_pums_data_more))

write_csv(pums_more, here("00_rawdata","pums_more.csv.gz"))
```

```{r Construct Plot on Urbanicity and Cost Burden, include=TRUE}
pums_more_1 <- pums_more %>%
  mutate(
    housing_cost = case_when(
      tenure == 3 ~ rent,
      tenure %in% c(1, 2) ~ owner_cost,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    
    cost_burdened = ifelse(
      !is.na(housing_cost) & income > 0,
      (housing_cost * 12) / income >= 0.30,
      NA
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(cost_burdened), income > 0)


puma_summary <- pums_more_1 %>%
  group_by(year, state, puma) %>%
  summarize(
    share_burdened = weighted.mean(cost_burdened, weight, na.rm = TRUE),
    population = sum(weight, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

puma_summary <- puma_summary %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  mutate(
    urban_category = case_when(
      population >= quantile(population, 0.75) ~ "More urban",
      population <= quantile(population, 0.25) ~ "Less urban",
      TRUE ~ "Middle"
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

urban_trend <- puma_summary %>%
  filter(urban_category != "Middle") %>%
  group_by(year, urban_category) %>%
  summarize(
    avg_burden = weighted.mean(share_burdened, population),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

urbanvsnonurban_plot <- ggplot(urban_trend, aes(x = year, y = avg_burden, color = urban_category)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.2) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  
  labs(
    title = "Housing Cost Burden in Urban vs Non-Urban Areas",
    subtitle = "Share of households spending ≥30% of income on housing",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Share cost-burdened",
    color = "Area type"
  ) +
  
  theme_minimal()

ggsave(
  filename = "costburden_urbannonurban.png",
  plot = urbanvsnonurban_plot
)

```

```{r Filter to Just Renters, include=TRUE}
pums_renters <- pums_more %>%
  filter(tenure == 3)

pums_renters <- pums_renters %>%
  mutate(
    housing_cost = rent,  # renters only
    
    cost_burdened = ifelse(
      !is.na(housing_cost) & income > 0,
      (housing_cost * 12) / income >= 0.30,
      NA
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(cost_burdened), income > 0)


puma_summary_renters <- pums_renters %>%
  group_by(year, state, puma) %>%
  summarize(
    share_burdened = weighted.mean(cost_burdened, weight, na.rm = TRUE),
    population = sum(weight, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

puma_summary_renters <- puma_summary_renters %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  mutate(
    urban_category = case_when(
      population >= quantile(population, 0.75) ~ "More urban",
      population <= quantile(population, 0.25) ~ "Less urban",
      TRUE ~ "Middle"
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

urban_trend_renters <- puma_summary_renters %>%
  filter(urban_category != "Middle") %>%
  group_by(year, urban_category) %>%
  summarize(
    avg_burden = weighted.mean(share_burdened, population),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

urban_trend_plot <- ggplot(urban_trend_renters, aes(x = year, y = avg_burden, color = urban_category)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.2) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(
    title = "Housing Cost Burden Among Renters: Urban vs Non-Urban",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Share cost-burdened",
    color = "Area type"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

ggsave(
  filename = "urban_trend_plot.png",
  plot = urban_trend_plot
)
```


```{r Difference Over Time Plot, include=TRUE}
urban_diff <- urban_trend_renters %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = urban_category,
    values_from = avg_burden
  )


urban_diff <- urban_diff %>%
  mutate(
    gap = `More urban` - `Less urban`
  )

ggplot(urban_diff, aes(x = year, y = gap)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.2) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  
  labs(
    title = "Urban vs Non-Urban Gap in Housing Cost Burden (Renters)",
    subtitle = "Difference in share cost-burdened (More urban − Less urban)",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Gap in cost burden"
  ) +
  
  theme_minimal()
```
